The company exhibits persistent, multi-year underlying unprofitability from an equity return perspective, evidenced by a 10-year median ROE of -1% [E19], a 5-year median of -2% [E20], a 3-year median of -3% [E21], and a trailing one-year median ROE of -5% [E22], culminating in an explicit Screener flag for a low return on equity of -2.97% over the last three years [E47]. Long-term profit creation is non-existent, with a 10-year compounded profit growth rate of 0% [E13] and a trailing twelve-month profit contraction of -18% [E14]. Furthermore, the business carries structural financial friction and balance sheet vulnerabilities, including low interest coverage [E46], a high cost of borrowing [E49], and substantial contingent liabilities standing at Rs. 31.6 Cr [E48]. Conceded: the stock demonstrates strong short-term momentum by trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages in a golden cross formation [E36, E54], paired with a recent net profit increase of 50% YoY [E51].
